artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the screen is rendered as illegible blobs rather than sharp characters. While low resolution contributes, AI generators often fail to render crisp UI text, resulting in 'fake' text artifacts.
The buttons below the screen lack distinct mechanical separation lines. They appear slightly fused into the casing, lacking the precise gaps expected in manufactured plastic electronics.
The boundary between the thumb/fingers and the device casing is slightly soft and indistinct, suggesting minor blending or edge bleeding typical of AI generation.
